svg.aria-label: The liwinux stack, from the game down to the hardware, and what liwinux does at each layer

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: The stack
liwinux does not ship its own Android. It assembles this stack, keeps it alive, and measures it.
LAYER
WHAT liwinux DOES HERE
Your game
an arm64-v8a APK, built for a phone
per-game profiles, a visual editor
keyboard, mouse and gestures mapped to its own layout
Android 13 — LineageOS 20 GAPPS
Play Store, Play Services, the usual app world
image selection and rebuild
VANILLA cannot run Play Store — the switch to GAPPS is scripted
ARM translation — libhoudini 14
arm64-v8a instructions on an x86_64 CPU
installed and verified against real games
without it most games do not start at all
Graphics — ANGLE → Mesa Venus → Vulkan
GLES on Vulkan, forwarded to the host GPU
NVIDIA path set up and measured
verified: Vulkan 1.3.341 on an RTX 3060, GPU rendering confirmed
Waydroid — the LXC container
the session, the composer HAL, the input pipes
supervision, crash-chain detection, recovery
a session tied to a terminal takes the whole of Android down with it
Linux host — Wayland, evdev, nftables, audio
the compositor, your devices, the firewall, PipeWire
network repair, audio-wedge repair, window control
a foreign nftables table can kill DNS while your own rules are correct
Measurement runs through all of it
frame timing, host resources and the Android log on one clock — so a stutter can be explained instead of guessed at
